policy: A Git worktree is not a security sandbox.
Use manual unless the user or project policy explicitly allows unattended execution for the task.
Reviewers and scouts should receive the least privileges required.
Command overrides in Orca may opt an agent out of global permission-mode migrations.

modeDefinitions.manual: The agent asks before consequential actions.
modeDefinitions.project-policy: Inherit the unattended-execution policy stated in the applicable project AGENTS.md. When that policy is silent, fall back to manual.
modeDefinitions.unattended: Apply the agent-specific unattended flag from unattendedArgs; only when project policy permits it and the Task is bounded.
